Counsel for Petitioner :- Hari Om Gupta Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard Shri Hari Om Gupta, learned Counsel for the petitioners and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 30.04.2024 lodged by the opposite party no. 4 in FIR/Case Crime No. 0116/2024, under Sections 354-B, 452, 504, 506 IPC and Section 7/8 Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, Police Station - Aspur Devsara, District - Pratapgarh, as contained in Annexure No. 1 to the writ petition.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. on the basis of instructions says that Section 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 POCSO Act are already added in the aforementioned FIR and Section 7/8 POCSO Act stands deleted.
Learned Counsel for the petitioners prays to withdraw the present petition with liberty to file a fresh petition with the aforementioned corrections.
The petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
